title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Kiwi Passion Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Kiwi Passion Lime delivers a bright and exotic fusion of sweet, tangy, and citrus flavours. The delicate sweetness of ripe Kiwi brings a juicy, tropical depth, while the tart and aromatic notes of Passionfruit add a lively contrast. A final burst of zesty Lime sharpens the blend, creating a bold and refreshing vape. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Kiwi Passion Lime is crafted to capture the layered, intense flavours commonly found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures long-lasting flavour while providing a smooth and consistent vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid offers a balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their dedication to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a favourite among vapers.
